entities.summary: Eloina Miyares Bermudez was a Cuban linguist and academician. She led the creation of the Diccionario Básico Escolar from its first edition in 2005 until its fourth edition. The Diccionario Básico Escolar is one of the books with the greatest circulation in Cuba.
